verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms GitLab has an importer to migrate repos, issues, PRs, wiki, labels, comments etc. from GitHub, which supports the 'move code from another platform' part of the story, and docs cover self-hosted install/scaling options relevant to moving to cloud. However, there is no explicit evidence of dedicated tooling for migrating users/accounts, permissions, or a comprehensive self-hosted-to-cloud migration path. missing for 10: documented user/account migration tooling, official self-hosted-to-SaaS migration guide, evidence of migration from platforms beyond GitHub (e.g., Bitbucket, SVN).
